title: Sub-game order preservation and values for TU-games
title_zh: 子博弈序保持与TU博弈的值
title_primary: 子博弈序保持与TU博弈的值
title_secondary: Sub-game order preservation and values for TU-games
authors: David Lowing, Satoshi Nakada, Florian Navarro
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In cooperative games with transferable utility (TU-games), a player’s contribution may vary depending on the coalition they join, reflecting different levels of synergy with other members. In this paper, we introduce a family of axioms referred to as sub-game order preservation axioms , which formalize the intuition that a player’s payoff should increase with the degree of synergy they exhibit within a coalition. We propose four distinct axioms, each of which captures a different interpretation of what constitutes synergy in the context of TU-games. We demonstrate that one of these variants is incompatible with the classical Efficiency axiom, thereby giving rise to an impossibility result. The remaining three axioms, when combined with Efficiency, lead to unique characterizations of three well-known solution concepts: the Shapley value, the Center of the imputation set (CIS), and the Equal allocation of non-separable contributions (ENSC) value, respectively.
abstract_zh: 在具有可转移效用的合作博弈（TU博弈）中，参与者的贡献可能因其加入的联盟不同而有所变化，这反映了与其他成员之间不同程度的协同效应。本文引入了一组公理，称为子博弈序保持公理，这些公理形式化了参与者的收益应随其在联盟中展现的协同程度增加而提高的直觉。我们提出了四个不同的公理，每个公理都捕捉了TU博弈背景下协同概念的不同解释。我们证明，其中一个变体与经典的效率公理不相容，从而产生了一个不可能性结果。其余三个公理在与效率公理结合时，分别导致了对三个著名解概念的独特刻画：沙普利值、分配集中心（CIS）以及不可分离贡献的均等分配（ENSC）值。

abstract_zh: 本文研究了产品责任诉讼对领先医疗器械企业新产品推出的影响。研究发现，在诉讼期间，被告企业（其他企业受影响程度较小）在涉诉产品类别中推出新产品的倾向有所降低。我们还表明，安全监管的变化会影响诉讼发生的可能性。最后，我们指出诉讼导致的潜在福利损失相对有限：新产品推出的下降并非永久性，不会溢出至涉诉类别之外，且诉讼会促使企业开发更安全的设备。（JEL D83, K13, L64, O31, O34）

title: The Effects of U.S. Public R&D on Global Growth
title_zh: 美国公共研发对全球增长的影响
title_primary: 美国公共研发对全球增长的影响
title_secondary: The Effects of U.S. Public R&D on Global Growth
authors: Gustavo De Souza, Andrew J. Fieldhouse, Karel Mertens, Ishan B. Nath, Valerie A. Ramey
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides the first causal estimates of the global social returns to U.S. public R&D. We use a narrative identification strategy to quantify the effects of exogenous shocks to U.S. R&D appropriations on the dynamic TFP response of 69 foreign economies from 1980–2019. A U.S. R&D appropriations shock equal to 1 percent of the federal R&D capital stock raises foreign TFP by approximately 1 percent after 12 years. This response is driven primarily by nondefense rather than defense R&D and is concentrated in non-OECD economies. These patterns are most consistent with diffusion occurring through openly accessible scientific content, capital-embodied trade, and technological leapfrogging by economies further from the global frontier. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the global social returns to U.S. public nondefense R&D are roughly twice as large as the domestic returns, meaning the U.S. captures about half of these productivity benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对美国公共研发的全球社会回报率进行了因果估计。我们采用叙事识别策略，量化了1980-2019年间美国研发拨款外生冲击对69个外国经济体动态全要素生产率（TFP）的影响。当美国研发拨款冲击相当于联邦研发资本存量的1%时，12年后外国TFP将提升约1%。这一响应主要由非国防研发而非国防研发驱动，且集中于非经合组织经济体。这些模式最符合以下扩散路径：通过公开可获取的科学内容、资本品贸易以及远离全球技术前沿的经济体的技术跨越。粗略估算表明，美国公共非国防研发的全球社会回报率约为国内回报率的两倍，这意味着美国仅获取了约一半的生产率收益。

title: Firm Concentration and Job Design: The Case of Schedule Flexible Work Arrangements
title_zh: 企业集中度与工作设计：以弹性工时安排为例
title_primary: 企业集中度与工作设计：以弹性工时安排为例
title_secondary: Firm Concentration and Job Design: The Case of Schedule Flexible Work Arrangements
authors: Abi Adams, Maria Balgova, Matthias Qian, Tom Waters
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how employer concentration affects job design, focusing on schedule flexibility as a non-wage job attribute. Using the full text of 46 million UK job vacancies from 2014–2019, we construct new measures of flexible work arrangements using supervised machine learning and large-language-model—assisted annotations. Adopting an instrumental variable strategy using a Bartik-style prediction of the change in employer concentration based on nationwide hiring trends, we show that higher concentration reduces the value of worker compensation partly through shifts toward “risky” flexibility that exposes workers to earnings volatility.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了雇主集中度如何影响工作设计，重点关注作为非工资性工作属性的排班灵活性。利用2014-2019年间4600万条英国职位空缺的全文数据，我们通过监督式机器学习与大语言模型辅助标注，构建了灵活工作安排的新测度。采用工具变量策略——基于全国招聘趋势对雇主集中度变化进行巴蒂克式预测——我们发现，更高的集中度会通过转向使工人面临收入波动的“风险型”灵活性，部分降低工人薪酬价值。

title: Diagnostic Thresholds, Written Consent Requirements, and the Utilization of Scarce Organs
title_zh: 诊断阈值、书面同意要求与稀缺器官的利用
title_primary: 诊断阈值、书面同意要求与稀缺器官的利用
title_secondary: Diagnostic Thresholds, Written Consent Requirements, and the Utilization of Scarce Organs
authors: Hannah Bae, Jeffrey Clemens
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper explores how diagnostic thresholds and a written consent requirement affect decision making between patients and transplant surgeons regarding the use of deceased donor kidneys. Combining administrative data on the universe of organ donors and transplant recipients in the United States, we show that age-based discontinuities within the Expanded Criteria Donor system (ECD), which was in place from late 2002 to late 2014, led to 4.0 and 5.4 percentage point differences in the rates at which otherwise indistinguishable kidneys were discarded. A discontinuity within the subsequent presentation of the Kidney Donor Profile Index (KDPI) led to a 2.6 percentage point difference. We present evidence that diagnostic thresholds have nuanced effects on decision making and information acquisition; procurement biopsy rates, for example, rose substantially at the ECD system’s age-based discontinuities. We further show that written consent requirements triggered within the ECD and KDPI labeling systems substantially reduced the number of potential recipients to whom kidneys were offered prior to being discarded. This channel can explain the majority of the increased rate at which “High-KDPI” kidneys are discarded under the current system.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了诊断阈值与书面知情同意要求如何影响患者与移植外科医生在已故供体肾脏使用方面的决策。结合美国器官捐献者与移植受者的全量行政数据，我们发现，2002年底至2014年底实施的扩展标准供体系统（ECD）中基于年龄的断点效应，导致原本无差异的肾脏被弃用率分别相差4.0和5.4个百分点。随后引入的肾脏供体概况指数（KDPI）系统中的断点效应，则导致弃用率相差2.6个百分点。我们提供的证据表明，诊断阈值对决策制定与信息获取具有细微影响；例如，在ECD系统的年龄断点处，活检获取率显著上升。我们进一步证明，ECD与KDPI标签系统触发的书面知情同意要求，大幅减少了肾脏被弃用前可供移植的潜在受者数量。这一机制可解释当前系统下“高KDPI”肾脏弃用率上升的主要原因。

title: Revisiting performance feedback: aspiration levels, underlying potential, and risk-taking behavior
title_zh: 重新审视绩效反馈：期望水平、潜在能力与风险承担行为
title_primary: 重新审视绩效反馈：期望水平、潜在能力与风险承担行为
title_secondary: Revisiting performance feedback: aspiration levels, underlying potential, and risk-taking behavior
authors: Junseo Seo, Kyung Yul Lee, Yukyeong Han, Dongjin Oh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study extends the behavioral theory of the firm by reconceptualizing performance feedback as a multidimensional construct that captures performance relative to aspiration levels and performance relative to underlying potential. We define four feedback categories: legitimated success (performance above both aspiration levels and underlying potential), fragile success (performance above aspiration levels but below underlying potential), potential-confirming failure (performance below aspiration levels but above underlying potential), and structural failure (performance below both aspiration levels and underlying potential). Using panel data on 213 team-seasons from the Korea Baseball Organization (2001–2025), we examine how each feedback type influences risk-taking decisions in the form of top leadership changes and workforce reconfiguration. Our analyses show that structural failure is associated with a higher likelihood of replacing the top leader, whereas legitimated success corresponds to greater leadership stability. In addition, potential-confirming failure triggers significant workforce reconfiguration, whereas both types of success entail minimal workforce changes. These findings highlight the importance of incorporating underlying potential into performance feedback evaluation. By jointly considering performance relative to aspiration levels and underlying potential, this study advances a more precise account of how firms interpret performance outcomes and, consequently, when they pursue strategic change versus reinforce the status quo.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过将绩效反馈重新概念化为一个多维构念（同时捕捉相对于期望水平的绩效和相对于潜在能力的绩效），拓展了企业行为理论。我们定义了四种反馈类型：合法化成功（绩效高于期望水平和潜在能力）、脆弱成功（绩效高于期望水平但低于潜在能力）、潜力确认型失败（绩效低于期望水平但高于潜在能力）以及结构性失败（绩效低于期望水平和潜在能力）。基于韩国棒球组织2001-2025年间213个团队赛季的面板数据，我们考察了每种反馈类型如何通过高层领导更替和劳动力重组的形式影响风险承担决策。分析表明，结构性失败与高层领导更替概率升高相关，而合法化成功则对应更高的领导稳定性。此外，潜力确认型失败会引发显著的劳动力重组，而两种成功类型均涉及最小程度的劳动力变动。这些发现凸显了将潜在能力纳入绩效反馈评估的重要性。通过联合考虑相对于期望水平和潜在能力的绩效，本研究更精确地阐释了企业如何解读绩效结果，进而决定何时追求战略变革或维持现状。关键词：绩效反馈 企业行为理论 潜在能力 领导更替 劳动力重组 JEL分类：L22 D81 M12

title: Departmentalized instruction and elementary school effectiveness
title_zh: 分科教学与小学教育效能
title_primary: 分科教学与小学教育效能
title_secondary: Departmentalized instruction and elementary school effectiveness
authors: Ben Backes, James Cowan, Dan Goldhaber
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Departmentalized instruction, in which teachers specialize in one or more core subjects and instruct multiple groups of students in a day, has become increasingly prominent in elementary schools. Departmentalization involves a potential trade-off: specialized assignments exploit teacher comparative advantage across subjects but introduce coordination costs across teams of teachers instructing common students. Using 8 years of data from Massachusetts and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate the effects of departmentalization on student achievement. Overall, we find that departmentalization has positive effects in English language arts (ELA) and science and either null or positive effects in math. Consistent with prior findings on teacher specialization, teachers are less effective when specializing in math and no more effective in ELA than when teaching self-contained classrooms. Rather, the improvements are driven by departmentalized schools assigning teachers to their stronger subjects.
abstract_zh: 分科教学（即教师专攻一门或多门核心学科，并在一天内教授多个学生群体）在小学中日益普遍。这种教学方式涉及一种潜在的权衡：专业化分工能够发挥教师在不同学科上的比较优势，但也会在教授同一批学生的教师团队之间产生协调成本。利用马萨诸塞州八年的数据及双重差分法，我们估算了分科教学对学生学业成绩的影响。总体而言，我们发现分科教学对英语语言艺术和科学学科具有积极影响，而对数学学科则呈现无影响或积极影响。与先前关于教师专业化的研究结论一致，教师在专攻数学时教学效率较低，而在英语语言艺术学科上的教学效果并不优于包班制教学。相反，学业成绩的提升主要源于分科学校将教师分配至其更擅长的学科。

title: Agricultural trade and adaptation to climate change in sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业贸易与气候变化适应
title_primary: 撒哈拉以南非洲的农业贸易与气候变化适应
title_secondary: Agricultural trade and adaptation to climate change in sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Obie Porteous
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Climate change is predicted to have large and heterogeneous impacts on agricultural yields. I use a model of production, consumption, and trade of 24 crops between 271 regions across sub-Saharan Africa to simulate the effects of climate change and explore how trade mediates these effects. I estimate a continent-wide welfare loss equivalent to 2.4% of GDP using median yield changes across 5 climate models, with country-level losses up to 60% of GDP in the worst model. The continent-wide welfare loss is 19% smaller with lower trade costs and over 7 times larger if trade flows are capped at current levels.
abstract_zh: 气候变化预计将对农业产量产生巨大且异质性的影响。本文利用一个涵盖撒哈拉以南非洲271个地区、24种作物生产、消费与贸易的模型，模拟气候变化的影响，并探讨贸易如何调节这些效应。基于5个气候模型的中位产量变化，我估算出全大陆福利损失相当于GDP的2.4%，而在最差模型下，国家层面的损失高达GDP的60%。当贸易成本较低时，全大陆福利损失减少19%；若贸易流量被限制在当前水平，损失则扩大7倍以上。

title: Large Language Model, trade threats and stock markets
title_zh: 大语言模型、贸易威胁与股票市场
title_primary: 大语言模型、贸易威胁与股票市场
title_secondary: Large Language Model, trade threats and stock markets
authors: Tian Yue, Zhixian Huang, Jiexiang Huang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how politically driven trade-threat signals affect global equity markets. Using a Large Language Model (LLM), we construct a measure of trade-threat intensity from U.S. president Donald J. Trump’s posts on Truth Social and identify extreme threat events based on the upper tail of the score distribution. We find that these events are associated with significantly negative abnormal returns in global equity markets, concentrated within a short window around the event date. The effect exhibits substantial regional heterogeneity, with weaker responses in the Americas and stronger reactions in European, Asian, and Pacific markets. Our findings suggest that LLM-based measures of political communication capture economically meaningful signals associated with short-horizon movements in asset prices, highlighting the role of real-time political rhetoric in shaping global financial market dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了政治驱动的贸易威胁信号如何影响全球股票市场。通过运用大语言模型（LLM），我们基于美国前总统唐纳德·J·特朗普在Truth Social平台上的帖子构建了贸易威胁强度指标，并根据得分分布的上尾部分识别出极端威胁事件。研究发现，这些事件与全球股票市场显著为负的异常收益率相关，且该效应集中在事件日期前后的短窗口期内。该影响表现出显著的区域异质性：美洲市场反应较弱，而欧洲、亚洲及太平洋市场反应更为强烈。我们的研究结果表明，基于大语言模型的政治沟通指标能够捕捉与资产价格短期波动相关的经济意义信号，凸显了实时政治言论在塑造全球金融市场动态中的作用。

title: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
title_zh: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验
title_primary: 倾向得分的平滑设定检验
title_secondary: A Smooth Specification Test for the Propensity Score
authors: Shiyao Huang, Xiaojun Song
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper proposes a simple smooth specification test for the propensity score in the spirit of Neyman (1937). We derive a particular restriction on the propensity score and construct the specification test based on it. Using the density‐weighting method, we transform the original specification testing problem into a test of the joint significance of the generalized Fourier coefficients. We propose a novel projection method to eliminate the parameter estimation effect arising from estimating unknown nuisance parameters. The proposed test is shown to follow a standard distribution under the null hypothesis and to possess nontrivial asymptotic power against local alternatives that converge to the null at the parametric rate , where is the sample size. To enhance the practical applicability of the procedure, we further introduce a data‐driven selection method for determining the testing order, enabling automatic selection based on the observed data. Compared to existing methods, our test does not suffer from the “curse of dimensionality” faced by Shaikh et al. (2009); at the same time, our test is both asymptotically pivotal and more computationally efficient than that of Sant'Anna and Song (2019). Extensive simulations demonstrate that the proposed test yields satisfactory empirical size and power. Compared with previous tests, our test exhibits comparable overall performance and delivers clear improvements in some cases, especially for high‐frequency alternatives. Two empirical applications further illustrate the practical applicability of our proposal, examining propensity score specifications in the Soviet 156 Program and the US Job Corps Program.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文提出一种基于Neyman（1937）思想的倾向得分平滑设定检验。我们推导出倾向得分的一个特定约束条件，并据此构建设定检验。通过密度加权方法，将原始设定检验问题转化为广义傅里叶系数联合显著性检验。我们提出一种新颖的投影方法，以消除估计未知冗余参数时产生的参数估计效应。所提出的检验在原假设下服从标准分布，并对以参数速率收敛于原假设的局部备择假设具有非平凡渐近功效，其中为样本容量。为增强方法的实际适用性，我们进一步引入数据驱动的检验阶数选择方法，实现基于观测数据的自动选择。与现有方法相比，本检验避免了Shaikh等（2009）面临的“维度灾难”；同时，相较于Sant'Anna和Song（2019）的方法，本检验既具有渐近枢轴性，又具有更高的计算效率。大量模拟表明，所提检验具有令人满意的经验水平和功效。与以往检验相比，本检验在整体表现上相当，并在某些情形下（尤其是高频备择假设）展现出明显改进。两项实证应用进一步验证了本方法的实际适用性，分别检验了苏联156工程和美国职业团计划中的倾向得分设定。

title: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
title_zh: 价格换取更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据
title_primary: 价格换取更安全的驾驶：肯尼亚小巴行为与习惯的证据
title_secondary: Safer Driving for a Price: Evidence on Behavior and Habits in Kenyan Minibuses
authors: David Schönholzer, Gregory Lane, Erin M. Kelley
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Road traffic injuries are the leading cause of death among people aged 5–29. Where traffic laws are weakly enforced, it is unclear whether road safety interventions can change behavior. We run a randomized controlled trial among 203 Kenyan minibuses, testing whether an incentive scheme improves safety overall or merely shifts unsafe driving to unmonitored times. Drivers reduce speeding by 29 percent and harsh braking by 13 percent, improving a safety index by 0.096 standard deviations. Labor-supply and earnings effects are modest, with little displacement across times or places. Improvements fade quickly, suggesting lasting change requires sustained enforcement or stronger incentives.

abstract: During the 2020–2021 “AAPI Hate,” mutual funds led by female managers perceived as East Asian underperformed relative to other female managers. This effect is stronger in states with higher anti-Asian animus, among more actively managed funds, and when these managers hold sole or senior roles. Factors concurrent with COVID-19, including childcare challenges, concerns for overseas families, marketplace and workplace discrimination, and exposure to the Chinese economy, cannot explain the effect. Underperformance is traceable to poor stock picking due to impairments in generating private information. Racial-ethnic animosity, even outside workplace or marketplace, hinders productivity and decision-making in high-skill professions.
abstract_zh: 在2020-2021年“亚裔美国人仇恨事件”期间，由被视为东亚裔的女性基金经理管理的共同基金，其表现逊于其他女性基金经理。这一效应在反亚裔情绪更强烈的州、主动管理程度更高的基金中更为显著，且当这些基金经理担任唯一或高级管理职务时尤为突出。与新冠疫情同步发生的因素，包括育儿挑战、对海外家人的担忧、职场与市场歧视以及中国经济敞口，均无法解释该效应。业绩不佳可追溯至因私有信息生成能力受损导致的选股失误。种族-民族敌意，即便发生在职场或市场之外，也会阻碍高技能职业的生产力与决策能力。

title: The Architecture of Social Networks and the Diffusion of Innovations
title_zh: 社交网络结构与创新扩散
title_primary: 社交网络结构与创新扩散
title_secondary: The Architecture of Social Networks and the Diffusion of Innovations
authors: Bryony Reich
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: For many technologies and behaviors, an agent’s benefit from adopting depends on his contacts adopting, and the benefit to his contacts of adopting depends on their contacts adopting. This paper examines how the architecture of these connections shapes the success or failure of the diffusion of innovations. We start with a standard model of diffusion with the key addition that some agents can coordinate their decisions. This captures the idea that people often talk and make decisions together with friends or family to adopt technologies. We show that insularity of connections, that is, the extent to which agents tend to concentrate their connections to a narrow set of other agents, determines contagion. However, whether insularity helps or hinders depends on the technology being diffused. For technologies that are valuable even without many contacts adopting, we find insular connections hinder adoption, but for technologies that are valuable only when many contacts adopt, insular connections facilitate adoption.
abstract_zh: 对于许多技术及行为而言，个体采纳的收益取决于其社交圈中他人的采纳情况，而他人采纳的收益又取决于其自身社交圈的采纳状况。本文探讨了这些连接结构如何影响创新扩散的成败。我们以标准扩散模型为基础，关键创新在于允许部分主体协调其决策。这反映了人们常与亲友共同商议并决定是否采纳技术的现实。研究表明，连接的封闭性——即个体将连接集中于狭窄群体的程度——决定了传染效应。然而，封闭性对扩散的促进或阻碍作用取决于技术特性：对于无需大量社交圈采纳即可产生价值的技术，封闭性会抑制采纳；而对于需依赖大量社交圈采纳才能体现价值的技术，封闭性反而促进采纳。

title: Norm-based enforcement of promises
title_zh: 基于规范的承诺执行
title_primary: 基于规范的承诺执行
title_secondary: Norm-based enforcement of promises
authors: Nathan Atkinson, Rebecca Stone, Alexander Stremitzer
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Considerable evidence suggests that people are internally motivated to keep their promises. But it is unclear whether such internal motivations create a meaningful level of commitment in economically relevant situations where promisors have strong self-interested reasons to break their promises. Self-interested incentives to break promises compete with—and so may overcome—the moral motivations of those who are internally motivated to keep them. We experimentally investigate the willingness of third parties to altruistically punish promise breaking. Participants observe a transaction between a potential promisor and promisee and can incur personal costs to punish the promisor for uncooperative actions. Our results suggest that the same moral reasons that motivate promisors to keep their promises make third-party observers more likely to punish promise breaking. This suggests that the same underlying promissory norms drive both (i) promise-keeping behavior in the absence of second- and third-party enforcement mechanisms and (ii) non-legal enforcement mechanisms that arise when third parties can punish potential promisors in a decentralized fashion. This makes it more likely that promissory norms support cooperative behavior
abstract_zh: 大量证据表明，人们内心有遵守承诺的动机。但在承诺方有强烈自利动机违背承诺的经济相关情境中，这种内在动机能否形成有意义的承诺约束尚不明确。违背承诺的自利激励与内在道德动机相互竞争——甚至可能压倒后者。我们通过实验研究第三方利他性惩罚违背承诺行为的意愿。参与者观察潜在承诺方与受诺方之间的交易，并可通过承担个人成本来惩罚承诺方的不合作行为。研究结果表明，促使承诺方信守承诺的道德理由同样会使第三方观察者更倾向于惩罚违背承诺行为。这意味着相同的承诺规范同时驱动着：（i）在缺乏第二方与第三方执行机制时的信守承诺行为；（ii）当第三方能够以分散化方式惩罚潜在承诺方时产生的非法律执行机制。这使得承诺规范更有可能支持合作行为。

title: Mining for Peace,
title_zh: 为和平而采矿
title_primary: 为和平而采矿
title_secondary: Mining for Peace,
authors: Roland Hodler, Paul Schaudt, Alberto Vesperoni
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the feasibility of opening new mines in ethnically diverse countries without escalating the risk of conflict. We propose a theoretical model in which ethnic groups can organize themselves to fight at the national or the local level. Our model yields two key insights. First, peace cannot be guaranteed in the presence of ethnic segregation and spatial resource inequality. Second, once the peace-maximizing policies are implemented, local conflict risks depend on local resource rents and local ethnic groups as well as the country’s entire ethnic and mining geography. We validate key concepts from our model using granular spatial data from Sierra Leone and the rest of sub-Saharan Africa and employing a shift-share identification strategy. We then apply these concepts to simulate the potential impact of planned mining projects in Sierra Leone and confirm that projects in the right locations can promote peace. We offer policy recommendations for making the mining industry a facilitator of peace and prosperity.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在多民族国家中开设新矿而不加剧冲突风险的可行性。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中各民族群体可在国家或地方层面组织起来进行斗争。该模型得出两个关键结论：第一，在存在民族隔离与空间资源不平等的情况下，无法保障和平；第二，一旦实施最大化和平的政策，地方冲突风险不仅取决于地方资源租金和地方民族群体，还取决于整个国家的民族与矿业地理格局。我们利用塞拉利昂及撒哈拉以南非洲其他地区的精细空间数据，并采用份额转移识别策略，验证了模型中的核心概念。随后，我们运用这些概念模拟了塞拉利昂计划中采矿项目的潜在影响，证实选址得当的项目能够促进和平。最后，我们提出政策建议，旨在使采矿业成为和平与繁荣的推动者。

abstract: Using a novel measure of investment companies’ reliance on generative artificial intelligence (GenAI), we document a sharp increase in GenAI usage by hedge funds after ChatGPT’s 2022 launch. A difference-in-differences test shows that hedge funds adopting GenAI earn 2-4% higher annualized abnormal returns than nonadopters, while non-hedge funds do not benefit. The outperformance originates from funds’ AI talent and ChatGPT’s strength in analyzing firm-specific information. We conduct a new survey of fund managers’ GenAI usage to provide direct validation of our measure and offer additional new insights on how managers adopt GenAI tools in their practice. abstract_zh: 利用投资公司对生成式人工智能（GenAI）依赖程度的新型度量指标，我们记录了2022年ChatGPT发布后对冲基金对GenAI使用量的急剧增长。双重差分检验表明，采用GenAI的对冲基金相较于未采用者，年化异常收益率高出2-4%，而非对冲基金并未从中获益。这种超额收益源于基金的AI人才储备以及ChatGPT在分析企业特定信息方面的优势。我们通过对基金经理GenAI使用情况的新调查，为这一度量指标提供了直接验证，并就基金经理如何在实践中采用GenAI工具提供了额外的新见解。（JEL分类号：C81, G11, G14, G23）

title: The mental health toll of heat stress in India
title_zh: 印度热应激对心理健康的损害
title_primary: 印度热应激对心理健康的损害
title_secondary: The mental health toll of heat stress in India
authors: Manuela Fritz
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The literature on the relationship between extreme heat and mental health in low- and middle-income countries has primarily focused on long-term and indirect channels, such as harvest failures and their impacts on mental health. In contrast, this study assesses the direct, short-term effects of heat stress on mental health and explores potential underlying physiological mechanisms. Moreover, by using a heat stress measure that accounts for non-linear interactions between heat and relative humidity (wet bulb temperature) and comparing it with conventional temperature measures (dry bulb temperature), I show that neglecting this interaction may underestimate the true effect. I combine data on self-reported depression and anxiety symptoms from four waves of the Indian WHO-SAGE survey with high-resolution climate data, exploiting quasi-random variation in heat exposure driven by the timing and location of survey implementation. The results show that exposure to extreme heat stress (wet bulb temperature) increases the reporting of depressive symptoms, but not of anxiety symptoms. The effects are consistently smaller and insignificant when dry bulb temperature is used together with humidity as linear control variable. The evidence points to heat stress exposure during agricultural work, increased cognitive difficulties, and sleeping disturbances as pathways linking heat stress and mental health among rural populations, while urban populations are not affected. Finally, the study shows that access to the District Mental Health Program plays a protective role, mitigating the negative impact of heat stress on mental health. These results underscore the need to integrate mental health into climate impact assessments and adaptation policies.

abstract: In this paper we focus on the analysis of ranking methods based on a lexicographic comparison of individual evaluations. Notable examples of ranking methods in this family are the majority judgement , the lexicographic excellence and its dual version. Making a bridge with the theory of lexicographic preferences on elements with multiple factors, we provide an axiomatic characterization of the family of lexicographic methods using three well-studied properties in social choice: Anonymity , Neutrality and Independence of Irrelevant Alternatives . These assumptions allow restricting the study to the set of individual evaluations rearranged in a non increasing way. Two further assumptions of Ordinal Invariance and Dominance (restricted to this domain) allow for the requested characterization. Some operational indications on how to establish the order used by the lexicographic procedure is also discussed.
abstract_zh: 本文聚焦于基于个体评价词典序比较的排序方法分析。该排序方法家族中的典型代表包括多数判断法、词典序卓越法及其对偶版本。通过建立与多因素要素词典序偏好理论的关联，我们运用社会选择理论中三个经过充分研究的性质——匿名性、中立性与无关选项独立性——对词典序方法家族进行了公理化刻画。这些假设将研究范围限定在按非递增方式重新排列的个体评价集合。在此基础上，两个附加假设（序数不变性与支配性，且限定于该领域）实现了所需的公理化表征。此外，本文还探讨了如何建立词典序程序所用排序顺序的操作性建议。

title: Greenwashing or brownwashing? Green bond issuance and corporate environmental decoupling
title_zh: 漂绿还是漂褐？绿色债券发行与企业环境脱钩
title_primary: 漂绿还是漂褐？绿色债券发行与企业环境脱钩
title_secondary: Greenwashing or brownwashing? Green bond issuance and corporate environmental decoupling
authors: Chao Wang, Dingkang Duan, Pengcheng Tang, Shuwang Yang
official: 官方在线 2025-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Green bonds not only serve as a financial instrument for corporations, but also as a critical mechanism to advance corporate environmental governance. Using a sample of Chinese A-share listed companies from 2012 to 2020, we use a multiple-period Difference-in-Differences methodology to investigate the impact of green bond issuance on environmental decoupling. Our analysis yields several key findings. First, green bond issuance significantly promotes environmental decoupling, the conclusion remains robust across various sensitivity tests. Second, green bond issuance facilitates environmental decoupling by attracting green-oriented managers and expanding firms’ rent-seeking opportunities. Third, in contrast to ‘brownwashing’, green bond issuance predominantly encourages ‘greenwashing’ behaviours. Fourth, compared to firms with stronger bargaining power, green bond issuance has a more pronounced impact on environmental decoupling in firms with weaker bargaining power. Fifth, principal–agent problems exacerbate environmental decoupling behaviour. This study provides compelling evidence on how green bonds influence corporate environmental decoupling, thereby contributing to a deeper understanding of green finance in the academic literature.
abstract_zh: 绿色债券不仅是企业的金融工具，更是推动企业环境治理的关键机制。本文以2012-2020年中国A股上市公司为样本，采用多期双重差分法考察绿色债券发行对环境脱钩的影响。研究发现：第一，绿色债券发行显著促进了环境脱钩行为，该结论在多种稳健性检验中依然成立。第二，绿色债券发行通过吸引具有绿色导向的管理者以及扩大企业寻租机会来推动环境脱钩。第三，与"漂绿"行为相反，绿色债券发行主要诱发"洗绿"行为。第四，相较于议价能力较强的企业，绿色债券发行对议价能力较弱企业的环境脱钩影响更为显著。第五，委托代理问题会加剧环境脱钩行为。本研究为绿色债券如何影响企业环境脱钩提供了有力证据，从而深化了学术界对绿色金融的理解。

title: Fiscal Dominance: Implications for Bond Markets and Central Banking
title_zh: 财政主导：对债券市场与中央银行的影响

official: 官方在线 2024-10-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Fiscal dominance refers to situations in which fiscal policy imposes restrictions on monetary policy. Large shifts in the dynamics of sovereign debts, surpluses, and central bank's balance sheets since the Great Financial Crisis have created the perception of a heightened risk of such fiscal dominance in major jurisdictions. This paper reviews the theoretical and empirical literature on fiscal dominance. We offer a simple theory in which fiscal dominance arises as the outcome of strategic interactions between the government, the central bank and the bond markets.
abstract_zh: 财政主导是指财政政策对货币政策施加约束的情形。自全球金融危机以来，主权债务、财政盈余及央行资产负债表的动态变化显著，导致主要经济体面临财政主导风险上升的认知。本文系统梳理了关于财政主导的理论与实证文献，并提出一个简约理论框架：财政主导是政府、央行与债券市场三方战略互动的结果。
